title: Preventive maintenance checks
bodyMd:
A passed check certifies the tested item against the stated maintenance standard only. Checks are counted once per item in this reporting cycle.

| Category | Checked items | Passed items |
|---|---:|---:|
| Ventilation | 80 | 72 |
| Lighting | 120 | 90 |
| Pumps | 200 | 180 |
